cli.rep.scelto_consigliato: chosen manually. For this source the recommended model would be {modello}: {motivo}
cli.rep.tempo_forchetta: the minimum if dedup finds the repeated frames animation usually has, the maximum if it finds none
cli.setup.ripiego_ffmpeg: Manual fallback: download {url}, extract '{nome}' and put it in {cartella}/
cli.setup.non_statico: {nome} downloaded but NOT static: it depends on external libraries and portability isn't guaranteed.
cli.setup.rimosso: Removed: a cut-down build would make a job fail halfway through.
cli.setup.ripiego_ncnn: Manual fallback: download {url} and extract the binary and models into {cartella}/
cli.setup.architettura: Architecture {arch} isn't handled automatically: copy the binaries and models into bin/ by hand.
cli.setup.gia_tutti: All binaries and models are already in bin/.
cli.setup.verranno: To make the folder self-contained, these will be downloaded:
cli.setup.peso: About {mb} MB in total. They'll go into bin/ and won't leave the folder.
cli.setup.annullato: Cancelled. Without these binaries no job can start.
cli.app.aiuto: AnimeUp — anime upscaler for Apple Silicon.
cli.analyze.aiuto: Analyse the sources and show the report, without changing anything.
cli.analyze.targets: Files or folders to analyse. Empty = the INPUT folder.
cli.analyze.duplicati: Analyse identical frames (costs a full decode).
cli.analyze.veloce: Skip fields and geometry: timing only.
cli.opz.targets: Files or folders. Empty = the INPUT folder.
cli.opz.forza: Go ahead even below the minimum upscale threshold.
cli.opz.preset: x265 preset: medium | slow | slower | veryslow.
cli.opz.disco: Maximum space per FILE, in GB: extracted frames, chunks and segments together.
cli.opz.modello: cugan | cugan-denoise | animevideov3. Empty = the recommended one.
cli.plan.aiuto: Show what would be done to each file, without running anything.
cli.run.si: Don't ask for confirmation before starting.
cli.run.pausa: Minutes of rest between one file and the next (0 = none): gives the CPU and GPU a breather on long marathons.
cli.run.pausa_prima: Rest BEFORE the first file too: the interface uses it for the commands after the first one in a chain.
cli.run.catena_totale: How many files the whole chain has (for the interface's "file N of M"): the UI passes it when it splits a launch into several commands. 0 = only this command's files.
cli.run.catena_inizio: How many files of the chain come BEFORE this command.
cli.run.lancio: Label shared by all the commands of one launch: it's used to put the summary back together when the interface splits a queue into several commands. Empty = a standalone command.
cli.run.niente_da_fare.uno: Nothing to do: {n} file already has its output in {cartella}.
cli.run.niente_da_fare.altri: Nothing to do: {n} files already have their output in {cartella}.
cli.run.interrotto: Stopped by the user: it can be resumed from {cartella}. Moving on to the next file.
cli.run.parziale: Partial work kept in {cartella} (running it again resumes from there).
cli.run.incompleta: Incomplete output, set aside as {nome}. Run again to redo it.
cli.run.incompleta_ferma: Incomplete output AND it can't be moved ({motivo}): delete {percorso} by hand before running again, or it will be skipped.
cli.doctor.aiuto: Check that the folder is self-contained and ready to use.
cli.doctor.rotti: One or more binaries are present but can't run: a truncated file, the wrong architecture, or the execute permission lost while copying. Try 'chmod +x bin/*' first, then './animeup setup'.
cli.doctor.autonoma: The folder is self-contained: you can move it to another Mac and it will work exactly the same.
cli.doctor.dipende: The folder still depends on system binaries.
cli.doctor.dipende_dettaglio:
The dependencies marked {marcate} would be missing
on a Mac without Homebrew. To fix it:  {comando}
cli.setup.aiuto: Download the missing binaries and models into bin/, to make the folder portable.
cli.ui.aiuto: Open the interface in the browser.
cli.ui.occupata: Port {porta} is already in use: another interface is open.
cli.ui.vecchia: That session keeps in memory the code from when it was started, so it wouldn't see the changes made since. Close it first:
cli.ui.indirizzo: Interface at {url} — Ctrl+C to stop it.
cli.tar.aiuto: Measure the speed of THIS machine and calibrate the estimates.
cli.tar.occupata: A job is running: stop everything from the interface (or wait for it to finish) and run the calibration again.
cli.tar.inizio: Calibrating on {chip} — this will take ~10 minutes.
cli.tar.fatto: Done: from now on the estimates on this Mac use these numbers.
cli.pausa: Pausing for {minuti} min to let the machine breathe...
cli.rep.esecuzione_valore.uno: {n} chunk of {frame} frames  -  peak disk use ~{picco} GB
cli.rep.esecuzione_valore.altri: {n} chunks of {frame} frames  -  peak disk use ~{picco} GB
cli.ui.rete: Also accept connections from other devices on your network (by default only this Mac can open the interface).
cli.ui.senza_browser: Don't open a browser window (used by the macOS app, which shows the interface in its own window).
cli.compare.aiuto: Run the clip comparison requested by the interface (used internally).
cli.serve.aiuto: Engine for the native app: JSON lines on stdin/stdout.
